_provenance.upstream_operation: sigGen AFT: hedged groups (deterministic = false) and internal-interface groups
_provenance.local_operation: C_CreateObject(CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKK_ML_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk). Hedged groups: C_SignInit with the extended signing structure (standard CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT / CK_HASH_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT fields, then pRandom = upstream rnd, 32 bytes): a test input supplied outside the PKCS#11 standard. Internal groups: the standard CKM_ML_DSA_EXTERNAL_MU with mu = SHAKE256(SHAKE256(pk, 64) || M', 64) computed by the workbench; hedged internal groups also supply rnd. Output byte-compared to the upstream signature.
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Scope: every upstream group the hub previously listed in notExecuted for the five optional-input reasons (no-pkcs11-encapsulation-randomness-input, hedged-rnd-not-injectable, hedged-additional-randomness-not-injectable, no-additional-randomness-injection, no-pkcs11-internal-interface). Per group: the case with the shortest message (mu for external-mu groups), ties broken by lowest tcId; for preHash groups only hashAlg values with a PKCS#11 route are eligible (CKM_HASH_<alg>_<hash>, or the generic CKM_HASH_<alg> with hash = CKM_SHA512_224 / CKM_SHA512_256), plus the shortest SHA2-512/224 or SHA2-512/256 case so the generic pre-hash route is exercised in every hedged preHash group. The same groups and cases as the pqctoday-hsm fixture rust/kat/acvp-randomness/nist_optional_input.json. All cases of every in-scope group run in the local full-vector test against the pinned upstream file.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, message|mu, rnd, sk, pk (internal external-mu=false groups only, needed for tr), context, hashAlg, signature (deferred dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into a session (CKA_TOKEN=false) object and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
